steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ in the browser. If not already signed in, sign in with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' — type the password into the password field exactly as the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (it gets filled in automatically when typed; do not guess or spell out any password). Verify you end up signed in as admin and report what the page shows.

02-open: Navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' in OpenProject (e.g. via the Projects menu), then open its work packages list. Find all work packages in that project whose subject starts with the text 'Seed:' and report their subjects EXACTLY as displayed, one per line, as a complete list. Do not modify anything — this is read-only. Report the full list of Seed: work package subjects.

03-change: On the Bench Project work packages list page ({{02-open.url}}), change the filters so that ALL work packages are shown regardless of status (e.g. remove the status filter or set it to show all/open+closed), then report the complete list of work package subjects whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed, along with their IDs and statuses. Read-only, do not modify anything.

04-create: In the OpenProject project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type 'Task' with subject exactly '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench work package for run {{runid}}'). Save it, then open the work package's own page and report: its subject, its type, its numeric ID as displayed (OpenProject shows it as #<number>), and confirm the description text contains {{runid}}. Do not modify any work package whose subject starts with 'Seed:'.
